scopes_needed_read: database users with db_datareader or custom read role
auth.refresh: Entra service principal client-credentials token for https://database.windows.net/

access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: A Microsoft Entra admin on the workspace creates a user for our Entra app in the target database and grants read, and opens the workspace firewall to our egress IPs. Note: Microsoft banner on the doc page states Fabric Data Warehouse is the new recommended path and dedicated pools can upgrade to Fabric.
access_requirements.cost_to_us: Customer pays serverless per-TB or dedicated DWU

customer_grant_statements: Run as the Microsoft Entra admin connected to the target database (serverless or dedicated):
CREATE USER [loveleeday-reader-app] FROM EXTERNAL PROVIDER;   (Microsoft doc form: CREATE USER [mike@contoso.com] FROM EXTERNAL PROVIDER; app display name used for a service principal)
Serverless: ALTER ROLE db_datareader ADD MEMBER [loveleeday-reader-app];   (docs: 'In Azure SQL Database or synapse serverless, use the ALTER ROLE statement.')
Dedicated pool: EXEC sp_addrolemember 'db_datareader', 'loveleeday-reader-app';   (docs: ALTER ROLE not supported in provisioned; use sp_addrolemember)
Docs caution: db_datareader is broad; prefer CREATE ROLE with GRANT SELECT on specific schemas.
Firewall: add our egress IP range as workspace firewall rule (portal step).

Caveat from docs: 'CREATE/ALTER/DROP LOGIN and CREATE/ALTER/DROP USER statements are not supported when Microsoft Entra-only authentication is enabled for the Azure Synapse workspace.' Check workspace auth mode first (UNVERIFIED how external-provider users behave under Entra-only).
data_objects_to_pull: customer-chosen tables, views, external tables over the lake
incremental_sync: Timestamp cursor or change tracking; no native CDC feed for dedicated pools (UNVERIFIED)
blockers: Product direction moving to Microsoft Fabric (doc banner) so prioritize Fabric Warehouse later
Entra-only auth workspaces change the user-creation path
sources: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/synapse-analytics/sql/sql-authentication — CREATE USER [mike@contoso.com] FROM EXTERNAL PROVIDER; 'In Azure SQL Database or synapse serverless, use the ALTER ROLE statement'; dedicated: EXEC sp_addrolemember
